title: AI News Daily — August 31, 2026
summary: OpenAI and Anthropic are buying and renting tens of thousands of Mac minis and Studios for AI workloads, an unplanned win for Apple amid a memory-chip shortage. Data centers are becoming a real midterm-election flashpoint, and X says a 200,000-account Chinese-linked bot network is amplifying the backlash. Also: OpenAI's ChatGPT ad business crosses $1 billion in annualized revenue.
